Central Siliguri: the densest zone

Babupara, Hakimpara, Mahananda Para, Ashrampara and the Hill Cart Road belt hold the biggest share of pujas. Dozens of pandals sit within a short walk of each other, so leave the vehicle outside and go on foot.

How to combine zones in one evening

  1. Pick one main zone and one neighbouring zone — never more than two.
  2. Visit the outer zone first in daylight (4–6 PM) when roads are still moving.
  3. Finish in a walkable cluster after dark, when vehicles slow to a crawl.
  4. Use the route planner to order the stops automatically.

Frequently asked questions

Which zone has the most pandals on the Siliguri pandal map?

Central Siliguri — the Babupara, Hakimpara, Mahananda Para and Hill Cart Road belt — has the largest number of pandals and is best explored on foot.

Can I cover all Siliguri zones in one day?

Not comfortably. Most visitors cover one or two zones per evening. Spread the five zones across Shashti to Navami for a relaxed Pujo.

Which zone is best for families with a car?

North Siliguri and parts of the west have wider roads and more pandals with parking than the crowded centre.

Is the zone-wise pandal map updated for 2026?

Yes. Every pandal uses its 2026 venue coordinates, and the lists on this page update automatically from the live pandal data.
